LOCK SAFETY -- this exact ALTER caused the 2026-08-11 P0 (an unbounded ALTER TABLE public.organizations queued for AccessExclusiveLock behind two ~50-minute census SELECTs; Postgres lock queues are FIFO, so every later lock request queued behind it, including PostgREST's schema-cache introspection, which hit its ~10s lock_timeout and entered a PGRST002 retry loop with no schema cache -- /api/v1/verify was down 11m39s). Both applies therefore carried 'SET lock_timeout = 5s' as the first statement in the same session as the DDL, so a blocked ALTER fails fast instead of forming a barrier. Preflight before the 0407 apply: 0 active queries older than 30s, 0 ungranted locks anywhere, 0 locks held on public.organizations by any backend.
